# hetznerrobot_subnet_mac (Data Source)

Reads the MAC address an IPv6 subnet is routed to, and the ones it could be routed to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hetznerrobot_subnet_mac" "v6" {
  ip = "2a01:4f8:111:4221::"
}

output "possible_macs" {
  value = data.hetznerrobot_subnet_mac.v6.possible_mac
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) Net address of the subnet.

### Read-Only

- `mac` (String) Current MAC address.
- `mask` (String) Prefix length of the subnet.
- `possible_mac` (Map of String) MAC addresses the subnet can be routed to, keyed by IP address.
